name: ui-tab-indicator-stretch
title: Tab Indicator
description: Vạch chọn dưới tab chạy sang tab mới: mép trước lao đi trước, mép sau đuổi theo sau nên vạch giãn dài rồi co lại vừa chữ.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tab-indicator, written here): Tabs HOME / WORK / ABOUT (12 px bold, centres 100 / 160 / 220). Indicator 3 px tall r1.5, width = label width. Each move: the edge on the travel side moves over 0.34 s power2.out, the other edge over 0.38 s starting 0.14 s later. Moves at 0.4 s (1→2), 1.5 s (2→3), 2.6 s (3→1). Labels brighten as the indicator centre comes within 46 px. Content panel: old fades out 0.12 s, new fades in 0.1-0.32 s. Cursor clicks 0.1 s before each move. Params: lead (0.34 s) · trail (0.38 s, trễ 0.14 s) · ease (power2.out) · moves [[giây, từ, tới]].
moworks.titleVi: Vạch tab co giãn theo hướng đi
